title: Mox's Shop
moral: Helping and fixing mistakes is important.

scenes.summary: Mox is a fox who owns a shop.
scenes.text: Mox is a fox. Mox has a shop.
scenes.image_prompt: cute cartoon fox chef standing proudly in front of a small colorful shop, children’s book style

scenes.summary: Bob the hog comes and helps Mox in the shop.
scenes.text: Bob is a hog. Bob helps Mox.
scenes.image_prompt: friendly cartoon hog helping fox chef in a kitchen shop, bright cheerful scene

scenes.summary: They begin cooking by mixing eggs together.
scenes.text: They mix eggs in a pot.
scenes.image_prompt: cartoon fox and hog mixing eggs in a big pot together, playful colorful kitchen scene

scenes.summary: Bob accidentally drops the eggs and makes a mess.
scenes.text: Bob drops the eggs. What a mess!
scenes.image_prompt: cartoon hog dropping eggs on the floor with shells everywhere, surprised expressions, bright colors

scenes.summary: Bob cleans up the mess and Mox praises him.
scenes.text: Bob mops and mops. Good job says Mox.
scenes.image_prompt: cartoon hog cleaning floor with mop while fox smiles and praises, happy ending scene
